notes.title: D.O.T Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today is a big day! We've just launched the Demo version of D.O.T!

After two years of development, we are thrilled to officially launch the Demo version of the game!
You can now play it and share your feedback! Tell us what you liked, what you don't liked at all, what thing should be added to the game, etc... We are open to all discussion!

Hope you have fun while playing the game!

- v38armageddon
